items.title: Frank Wess — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: once I was in Chicago I went into hear Coltrane and he played

ctx.x: Why do you think that is?

That’s the way they’re taught. That’s the way they’ve been taught, patterns and things. In the schools they teach you how to play, but they don’t teach you how to stop. You see, so it’s very important to know how to stop playing when you should stop playing. I hear it time and time again. Once, I was in the Vanguard and there was this saxophone player, tenor saxophone player, I can’t remember his name and he really wasn’t taking no prisoners. You could tell he had the whole audience with him and everything and…
